## Our StoryBuilt on one idea: small businesses grow on relationships.

### Where it started

Levitate founder Jesse Lipson has always loved creating magic. As a kid, he learned magic tricks. As an adult, the magic comes in the form of innovative software.

Jesse had already founded ShareFile, secure file-sharing software for small businesses that was later acquired by Citrix. Along the way, he noticed something about his own habits. The people and companies he gave repeat business to were the ones who did a good job of keeping in touch and staying top of mind. Most small businesses didn't have the time to do that.

He went looking for software to help. Everything he found was built for large, product-oriented companies. Nothing was made for service-focused small businesses, where relationships are how you grow, or sometimes just survive.

So in 2017, Jesse designed a CRM-light system built for relationship-based businesses. It began with keep-in-touch reminders and personal key facts, the small details worth remembering about the people you serve. The idea was never to send more marketing. It was to make genuine, personal outreach possible for people too busy to do it.

![A young Jesse Lipson working at a laptop](https://www.levitate.ai/company/story-jesse.webp)

### What it became

In less than a decade, that idea has grown into a platform used by nearly 9,000 businesses across the US. Email became the heart of the product, built for personal outreach at scale and sent from your own email account so it arrives the way a note from you should. Texting, social media, blogs, Google reviews, surveys, events, and websites followed, along with automations that keep every follow-up on schedule. Levitate works for any business that grows on relationships.

![The Levitate team in front of the Nasdaq billboard in Times Square](https://www.levitate.ai/company/story-nasdaq.webp)

### Where we're going

We put .ai in our name in 2017, years before AI went mainstream. For years, the idea was ahead of the technology. Software could remind you to reach out and help you write a message, but writing a genuinely different message to hundreds of people, each one reflecting what you actually know about them, still took a person, one email at a time.

That has changed. CRMs remember your customers. Marketing tools send messages. With AI, Levitate can finally do what neither could: work across the history, notes, and data your business already keeps to figure out who needs attention, what to say to them, and when to say it. We call it Relationship Intelligence. It's the idea Levitate was founded on, finally with the technology to match.

It's why Levitate now briefs you before client meetings, watches your inbox and drafts your replies, and can write a different email for every person on a list. Every client can feel known, without adding to your workload.

We build on the best AI available. Levitate builds with Claude and is part of the OpenAI Partner Network, and we're SOC 2 audited, because AI that touches your client relationships has to be trustworthy.

And when a business needs Relationship Intelligence shaped around the way it works, our [AI Solutions team](https://www.levitate.ai/ai-solutions) builds it, on Levitate or on the tools the business already uses.

The Customer Promise

> AI should help a small business behave more like the best version of a careful human relationship manager, not like a larger blast engine.

### The people behind it

Levitate is powerful software with a dedicated team behind it. Every customer works with a Success Specialist who knows their business. Our support team has won awards, and most support requests get a first reply in under an hour. And our AI does the heavy lifting because our people make it better.

The magic isn't only in the software. It's in how we work together. Every customer win, employee win, and sale gets celebrated company-wide, with credit going to everyone who helped make it happen, because nothing here is a solo effort. Our Circle of Magic is an annual reward trip for top performers from every department, not just sales.

It shows. Inc. has named Levitate to its 5000 list for four consecutive years, and Forbes has named us one of America's Best Startup Employersthree years in a row.

![Levitate Circle of Magic winners at night in Paris, with the Eiffel Tower lit up behind them](https://www.levitate.ai/company/story-circle-of-magic-paris.webp)

Circle of Magic, our annual reward trip for top performers from every department.

The goal hasn't changed since 2017: help the businesses that grow on relationships keep those relationships strong, without it taking over their day. The tools are better now. And the magic doesn't stop there.
